name: El Salvador (12 stars, 1869–1873)
description: Nine alternating horizontal stripes of blue and white with a red canton bearing twelve white five-pointed stars in three rows of four.
history: Version of the 'conservative flag' adopted on 28 April 1865 under President Francisco Dueñas, modelled on the flag of the United States with one star per department. A twelfth star was added in 1869 for the new department of Ahuachapán; a thirteenth followed in 1873 for Cabañas.
